source_instruction: i would like a white foot file for dead skin.
query: Ugh, I just got back from walking my rescue golden retriever who decided to roll in a whole patch of muddy clover on the trail, and now I have to scrub my rain boots twice before I can even leave them by the door. I stopped at the corner boba shop on the way home too, and they messed up my order by putting boba in my jasmine tea when I specifically asked for lychee jelly, which is such a bummer because I hate how chewy regular boba gets when it sits too long. I also need to remember to pick up extra cat litter tomorrow because my tabby has been kicking half of it out of her box lately and making a huge mess on the bathroom tile. Anyway, I’m looking for skin care tools that get rid of dead skin, I want the 001-white option, and I don’t want to spend too much on it.
